title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 1 — Motion-Adaptive EMA v1 Development Smoke Protocol
research_question: If EMA response speed increases deterministically with current frozen primary-subject motion, can TS-2 preserve low-motion smoothing while reducing the strong-motion lag observed for fixed-alpha TS-1?

spatial_failure.mechanism: Fixed alpha=0.5 EMA lags the current raw composition during large primary-subject motion.

scientific_variables.ts0: Stage 5.3 FINAL FROZEN CMP-1; no temporal smoothing
scientific_variables.ts1: ema_crop_center_v1; fixed alpha=0.5 reference retained unchanged
scientific_variables.only_changed_variable: The continuous-transition EMA coefficient changes from fixed alpha=0.5 to deterministic alpha_t=f(m_t).
unchanged: sanitized primary subject and primary bbox

motion_definition.X_t: Current sanitized primary-subject horizontal center before crop clamp, identical to the existing Stage 5.4 TemporalObservation signal.
motion_definition.eligible_transition: Adjacent frozen frames within one video, frame gap exactly 1, with neither current nor previous frame in fallback.
motion_definition.normalization: Frame width W; identical to Stage 5.4 normalized horizontal displacement.

piecewise_interpretation: 0.10 < m_t < 0.20: alpha_t increases linearly from 0.5 to 1.0
alpha_schedule.threshold_source: 0.10 and 0.20 are already frozen Stage 5.4 large-jump thresholds; 0.20 is also the preregistered material large-jump gate. The schedule reuses the existing scientific scale instead of introducing a second motion normalization or result-fitted decimal.
alpha_schedule.state_update: S_t = alpha_t*X_t + (1-alpha_t)*S_(t-1), with the same alpha_t applied to the paired x/y crop-center state; alpha_t is driven only by frozen horizontal m_t.

parameter_candidate_set.reason: The frozen 0.10/0.20 motion boundaries determine one interpretable schedule; no Smoke-only candidate comparison is necessary.

reset_semantics.NEW_VIDEO: State never crosses video_id; the first non-fallback frame initializes from its own raw center.
reset_semantics.FRAME_GAP_GT_1: A frozen frame-id gap greater than 1 resets state before the current frame.
reset_semantics.FALLBACK: A fallback frame emits the frozen center crop and clears state; the next non-fallback frame initializes from its own raw center.
reset_semantics.scene_or_shot_reset: NONE; TS-1 has none and Amendment 1 does not add one.

smoke.selection: Reuse the existing model-blind Stage 5.4 Smoke24 exactly; no video or frame reselection.

coverage_audit.conclusion: The frozen manifest covers low, transition-band, and full-response motion and contains strong-off-center frames that expose the lag mechanism.

amendment_mechanism_checks: TS-2 strong-off-center mean-visible delta versus TS-0 must be no worse than TS-1 versus TS-0 on the same Smoke frames.
TS-2 subject-center-containment delta versus TS-0 must be no worse than TS-1 versus TS-0 on the same Smoke frames.
For every eligible m_t >=0.20 transition, alpha_t must equal 1.0.
decision_rule.promotion_rule: Only if every engineering gate, every unchanged Stage 5.4 scientific gate applied to TS-2 versus TS-0, and every amendment mechanism check passes may TS-2 be proposed for a separate PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FORMAL freeze. Smoke itself never freezes or validates TS-2.
decision_rule.failure_rule: Any failure stops promotion. Do not change the schedule, thresholds, gates, exclusions, or manifest after seeing Smoke; a new method would require a new amendment protocol.

all_must_pass: TS-0, TS-1, and TS-2 frame identity identical
TS-1 and TS-2 crop sizes and targetRatioWH unchanged
protocol/config snapshots and artifact manifest generated

runtime.resume: Same immutable identity plus --resume; completed per-video shards are reused.
runtime.output_collision: A non-resume start refuses an existing output identity; no overwrite, reset, clean, or automatic deletion.

determinism: Pure CPU arithmetic over SHA-frozen inputs; a complete second in-process build must have the same canonical record SHA.
formal_freeze_procedure: After Smoke, a human reviews raw evidence. If and only if promotion gates pass, a later preparation round freezes the exact algorithm/code/config identity in a separate PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FORMAL protocol before any Dev166 TS-2 execution. This DRAFT is not a Formal preregistration.
limitations: The frozen primary bbox is a detector artifact, not official composition GT.
Visible fraction and subject-center containment are geometry diagnostics, not official test metrics.
Weak spatial references remain diagnostic only and are not used by the algorithm or promotion rule.
Smoke24 is a development subset and cannot establish Heldout or official-test generalization.
references: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
